scope: 31 power-assembly types, 35 unique cited source pages, 124 actual CPU-rendered model views and 31 icons. Supersedes the baseline rejection report only for these exact frozen hashes.
result: All 31 geometry types and all 31 icons approved for source-visible illustrative topology.
verification: Visually inspected all 35 cited source WebPs, with enlarged plan crops where needed.
Read actual geometry, icon, type and effective per-page layout code.
Visually inspected all 31 revised types in perspective/front/end/plan CPU QA; rechecked final changed terminal/fan cases after freeze.
Visually inspected final icon sheet at useful size, including p123 central-gap fan locations.
Constructed every actual Three.js power geometry read-only; radiator unit counts match all cited source plans, not just definition prose.
Verified all seven frozen library/evidence/binding file hashes and supplied render-report hash against actual filesystem bytes.
limits: No dimensions, tolerance, exact SKU match, catalogue rating equivalence, hidden internals or unpictured equipment certified.
Individual radiator fin counts are illustrative; separate-unit counts and leaf-stack orientation are source-grounded.

Minor brackets, pipes, terminal carriers, cabinet controls and fasteners are simplified. Extra unlabelled roof insulators are represented by visible shape only; their electrical purpose is not inferred.
For p115 and p123, unestablished fan internals remain opaque source-visible cooling housings; no total hidden fan count is asserted.
CPU rasterization only; interactive browser controls, WebGL/GPU shading, camera input and disposal lifecycle are outside this visual approval.
Icons are compact oblique schematics. Close terminals and source-side groups may overlap visually at small sizes; they are not source-view-accurate construction drawings.
Approval expires for any changed reviewed library/source/render dependency; subsequent repairs require verification.
